$comment: Hand-authored published catalog for the Watch Face Format (WFF) target. It states builtins only: every component mirrors a WFF element, with WFF attribute names as property names, positioned in px of the WatchFace's width x height (default 450 x 450). The exporter is WatchFaceXmlExporter and the importer WatchFaceXmlImporter, both in :ui-builder-export; wff/raw carries what import cannot model. The templates are the two documents under wff-watchface/designs/.

wasm.reason: The fast section plays the face as a Remote Compose document in the browser, several devices side by side. It is a different program from the watch's face runtime, so spacing, fonts and complications are an impression; check the Android Watch Face runtime preview.

native.reason: A real Android Declarative Watch Face runtime, streamed from a daemon: the same WFF XML or DWF bundle this catalog exports.

properties.name: width
properties.notes: The WatchFace width in px. Default 450.

properties.name: height
properties.notes: The WatchFace height in px. Default 450.

properties.name: clipShape
properties.notes: WatchFace clipShape.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.notes: Scene backgroundColor, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

properties.name: clockType
properties.notes: Metadata CLOCK_TYPE; inferred from the clock elements when absent.

properties.name: previewTime
properties.notes: Metadata PREVIEW_TIME, e.g. 10:08:32.

properties.name: wffVersion
properties.notes: The Watch Face Format version the XML targets (1-5). Default 2. Declare the same value in the manifest.

properties.name: verbatim
properties.notes: Set by import: the WatchFace frame is held in this document (`face` slots, `faceAttrOrder`), so no version comment or Metadata is generated.

properties.name: wffExtras
properties.notes: Import only: a JSON object of strings holding what has no property of its own: the attribute order (`wffAttrOrder`, `faceAttrOrder`, `<inner>AttrOrder`), attributes this vocabulary does not model (`renderMode`, `font:weight`) and values a typed property cannot carry (`2.0`, `[WEATHER.TEMPERATURE]`). Read wherever the named property is absent. An order is authoritative: an attribute it does not list is not written unless its property is set. Layout keys: `coreAt` (where the element's own part sits among its children), `shapeChildOrder`, `slotChildOrder`, and for a text template `templateCData` and `templateTail`.

properties.name: xml

Holds what has no wff/ element (Metadata, BitmapFonts, Expressions, Transform, gradients, Localization, unknown future elements) and the comments of an imported face. Editing it is checked: the XML must be well formed, one element or comment, and an element keeps the element name it replaces.
